submittedPrompt: 绘制中文博客网页局部状态对照板，白底浅灰面、蓝色主动作、细线小圆角、字体清晰紧凑。每行是独立状态，细线留白分隔，只画指定组件，不画外部导航/页头、浏览器或审查注释。五行紧凑局部，可加高。1 红色“请选择 JPEG、PNG 或 WebP 图片。”。2 裁切局部：固定16:9山景预览，没有拖拽手柄/虚线选区；三个原生滑杆标签“缩放”“水平位置”“垂直位置”，缩放滑块最左，两个位置滑块居中。按钮“选择图片”“裁切并上传”“取消裁切”均可用。3 另一上传中的相同山景裁切局部，仍保留图片及三个同名滑杆；选择图片与所有滑杆灰色禁用，按钮“正在上传…”转圈禁用、“取消裁切”禁用；状态“正在处理并上传图片，请稍候…”。4 上传失败的独立裁切局部，仍保留山景与三个同名滑杆，全部恢复可用，按钮“裁切并上传”“取消裁切”可用，红色“图片上传失败，请重试。”。5 取消裁切后仅保留旧图片选择状态：标题“上传并裁切封面”，按钮“选择图片”和文字按钮“移除”，提示“支持 JPEG、PNG、WebP，最大 10 MB。选择后可调整裁切范围。”，普通状态“已选择图片”；第五行不显示裁切预览、滑杆或取消按钮。全图不画旋转、重置、拖拽点、裁切比例按钮或额外输入。

sourceContracts.title: 博客图片：裁切与上传
permissionRules: Owner session required for design/media APIs. Saving a draft, private preview or restoring history does not publish; version-checked explicit publish changes guest homepage.

fields.name: file
fields.constraints: JPEG/PNG/WebP; chooser<=10MB; cropped WebP output<=1600px wide; processed design upload<=5MiB

actions.label: 裁切并上传
actions.effect: Process chosen crop and upload to current destination

importantStates: processing/uploading locks controls; upload failure retains crop

responsive.supported: Source-defined responsive layout; not runtime-verified in this read-only inventory
responsive.behavior: <=1250px editor/preview stack; <=760px forms/cards/dialog compress. Preview internally keeps 1100px desktop or 375px mobile viewport and scales to host (BlogPreviewViewport.vue:34). Runtime unverified.

sourceContracts.designReason: A concrete state with its own content, action hierarchy and business state; include in the GPT Image 2 review queue before implementation.
notes: Avatar aspect1:1; homepage banner3:1; article cover16:9. UI chooser10MB and processed design upload5MiB are different constraints.

postprocessing: Original built-in PNG copied byte-for-byte; no pixel edits.

concerns: Static raster is not proof of executed actions, owner/recipient permissions, focus/keyboard, guard enforcement, canvas topology or responsive fit.
Light raster shading and approximate geometry are illustrative; exact source labels and shared flat CSS tokens remain implementation requirements.
